'''Farseer Inc''' is a surface Engineer base in the '''[[Deciat]]''' system, and the workshop of '''[[Felicity Farseer]]'''.<ref name="inara-farseer-inc">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52125/ Farseer Inc in Deciat — Station], Inara.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Deciat]]
* '''Body:''' Deciat 6a
* '''Landing pad:''' Large
* '''Permit required:''' No<ref name="inara-farseer-inc" />

== Engineer ==

Farseer Inc is operated by '''[[Felicity Farseer]]'''. See [[Felicity Farseer]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements to access her workshop.

== Station Services ==

Farseer Inc offers a commodity market, outfitting, rearmament, refuelling, repairs, shipyard services, black market, Fleet Carrier services, and a technology broker, in addition to Felicity's Engineering workshop.<ref name="inara-farseer-inc" />
